pages.text: The super nova has caused no more slimes to spawn in the overworld. However, a little known fact remains true of the $(item)$(l:generating_flowers/narslimmus)Narslimmus/$: it can consume naturally spawned Magma Cubes. The normal restriction applies that the chunk that the Magma cube spawned had to be a slime chunk. The $(l:tools/slime_bottle)$(item)Slime in a Bottle$(0)$(/l) can help with that in the nether.
